source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Open the inspection report for the failed test.
3. Record the vehicle ID
4. Scroll down and find the failed brake test
5. Open dropdown
6. Record the time, date, and location of the failed test
7. Click on the link that is highlighted green to open the associated inspection report
8. Scroll to the bottom of the inspection report
9. Record the time and date that the brake test was performed
10. Close the failed brake test inspection report
10. Click on the link that is highlighted green to open the associated inspection report
12. Record the time and date that the pre-test inspection was performed
14. Go back to the inspection port for the failed test
15. Scroll to the bottom of the braking system section
16. Record the information in the 'Notes' field
17. Close the inspection report
18. Record the time and date
